mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POSTING_APP_RESPONSE(ID, STATUS_ID, P_APPLICATION_ID, P_ID) VALUES(SEQ_POSTING_APP_RESPONSE.NEXTVAL, 1, #{p_application_id}, #{p_id})
mapper.select: SELECT PAR.ID AS id , PAR.STATUS_ID AS status_id , PAR.P_APPLICATION_ID AS p_application_id , PAR.P_ID AS p_id , PAR.RESPONSE_DATE AS response_date , PAS.STATE AS state FROM POSTING_APP_RESPONSE PAR, POSTING_APP_STATUS PAS WHERE PAS.ID = PAR.STATUS_ID AND ID = #{id}
